blocks.text: National Scientist and agriculture guru Dr. Emil Q. Javier once noted that our most modernized agriculture industries are those where government has largely kept its hands off. In stark contrast, those where government intervention is heaviest, namely rice, coconut, and sugar—each even having a dedicated agency—are now the most backward and troubled.
